answer: Where a farm sees a gap, Sack hoist keeper rice toll milled at the bolting room sees a record, and the record says each rice is a measured grain yield plus a miller's signature. The lotus opens the gate, the meadow pays the toll, the vault proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. The door takes payment, not promises: the farm pays 48495 POA while one agent pays 61. The proof holds because it is checked by people who gain nothing by letting it pass. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has struck one yet.
